measurement_amendment: Use already extracted MBP-1 earliest valid event quote at each original execution target instead of trade-triggered TBBO. Original signals, dates, thresholds, exclusions and denominators unchanged.

economic_preregistration.later_stages: 2024-2025 contaminated validation and available 2026 extension reported separately; none is pristine confirmation
economic_preregistration.capital: $100 compounded, and fixed $100 per trade; idle cash zero interest
economic_preregistration.costs: Observed spread plus 1bp adverse execution each side, sell notional fee 0.0000051 plus $0.000119/share; fixed research assumptions, not historical fee reconstruction. Stress adds $0.01/share on each side.
economic_preregistration.robustness: Matched delay subsets, remove top ten primary trades, 5-session block bootstrap excess versus SPY total return (5000 draws, seed 400907).
economic_preregistration.benchmark: SPY adjusted daily close total-return proxy, first day adjusted open to close then close-to-close, over full stage calendar; separate matched-session passive SPY and same-window SPY ask-to-bid controls. Missing signal execution is unresolved, not cash.
economic_preregistration.controls: Original overnight sign; prior-close-to-official-open UPRO return minus SPXU return sign; raw UPRO+SSO opening quantity minus SPXU+SDS sign (deliberately unnormalized raw participation control); prior trading-session consensus direction. Controls use matched executable primary dates; no sign optimization. Relevant 1x/2x/3x ladder also reported.
economic_preregistration.admission: Development compounded net return must exceed SPY; bootstrap lower 95% excess bound >0; cent stress and remove-top-ten must remain profitable. Failure is terminal; later historical stages descriptive only.
economic_preregistration.limits: Full local quotes absent for 28 late-2026 dates; never invent fills or mark missing signals as cash. Fractional fills, settlement and executable capacity not operationally validated; daily drawdown only.
